title: Historic Kabaddi Achievement
body:
Lawrence High School proudly celebrates a remarkable achievement at the CISCE National Kabaddi Championship 2026 held in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh.

Our students Kalpana Bhattacharya (8A), Pranitha P (7D), Amritha Roy (7F), Rachana V (9B) and Mishitha Roy (10A) proudly represented Karnataka as the team emerged victorious at the national championship.

Kalpana further made history as the first Lawrence student to qualify for the prestigious SGFI Matches and was honoured with the Best Defender Award.

A proud milestone celebrating teamwork, determination and sporting excellence at Lawrence.

photos.alt: Lawrence High School girls kabaddi team with medals and the CISCE National Kabaddi Championship 2026 trophy in Meerut
